Name: Farmhouse Bathroom
Author: livipup
Description:
This mod adds a bathroom to the dining room renovation for the farmhouse. This bathroom has two functional features. The first, you can relax in the bathtub to restore your energy. The second, the mirror can be used to access the Shrine of Illusion menu. Doing so will still cost 500G unless you have a mod which changes the original shrine to remove this cost.

The latest version of this mod was made using the tiles from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1626]Compact Bathroom For Your Farmhouse[/url] by Prismuth. Please consider leaving a kudos on Prismuth's profile or checking out the original mod the tiles came from if you like this mod.

Downloads.Description: Fixed an error in the content data. If you already downloaded v3.1 you do not need to download again. I reuploaded only to fix the manifest file.
